quarterly_data.signal: Q3 2026 results (quarterly report): Q3 revenue RMB 1,919,890,131.39, up 29.64% YoY; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 599,081,831.05, down 84.32%, and net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 592,678,125.02, up 24.88%. First nine months: revenue RMB 5,665,584,178.44, up 42.45%; net profit attributable RMB 1,802,528,508.85, down 61.68%; excluding non-recurring items RMB 1,798,919,548.79, up 32.97%; operating cash flow RMB 4,508,025,991.98, up 63.10%. The company says revenue and cost grew with the scale of a smoothly expanding AIDC compute business, and the net-profit decline is mainly because the prior-year period included investment income from issuing a REIT (investment income down RMB 37.36 hundred million).

quarterly_data.signal: Compute build-out (quarterly report): construction in progress rose 115.07% to RMB 15,171,590,802.73 at September 30, 2026, mainly on more computing equipment; cash paid for fixed and other long-term assets was RMB 11,418,699,105.47 in the first nine months versus RMB 7,993,970,523.29 a year earlier; intangible assets rose 57.94% to RMB 2,150,868,577.65, mainly new land-use rights for the Hong Kong and Indonesia computing centers; equipment prepayments lifted other non-current assets 271.09% and equipment payables lifted accounts payable 95.59%; R&D expense RMB 208,696,882.22, up 44.29%.
